convention: Network address digits run most-significant to least-significant. axis_order lists network digit axes in visual digit order. bin_orders[axis][visual_bin] gives the network bin. display_to_slot[visual_row*64+visual_col] is the raw slot ID.
objective: Mean across eight successful examples: 4x4 group signal/noise total variation + 0.6 directed centroid separation + 0.2 signal group concentration + 0.2 adjacent signal group mass. Signal combines GSU-effective needle writes, answer reads, and their geometric mean; noise uses GSU-effective noise writes.
